statement: MasterSite catalogs Commodities — Kalshi Research Exchange in Markets & Trading Research; its recorded Pages status is built.

value.description: Evidence-first paper-trading lab for Kalshi event contracts, organised around an automated forward-test desk. 23 return-seeking strategy personas (plus 4 gated ones) trade open Kalshi contracts on paper twice an hour from a scheduled, read-only GitHub Actions collector, and every fill, exit, settlement, intent, mark and order book is committed back to the repository. Two backtests run on verified official Kalshi price data: the original hand-collected sample (3 settled markets, 130 verified bars, 5 personas), deliberately frozen, and an archive backtest replayed bar by bar over the candle archive the collector now stores (45 markets, 1,691 verified bars, 199 trades, 9 rule sets, with per-trade equity curves and a walk-forward stability split). An execution-realism check re-reads every simulated fill against Kalshi's own published trade tape via GET /markets/trades and reports the difference in cents, with a committed live result of 158 fills compared at a median absolute desk-minus-tape gap of 1.00 cent. A season health audit (scripts/audit_season.py) checks the schedule, ledger coverage, storage compaction, signal adapters and the tape summary, re-reads settled markets against the official API on the runner, and refuses to let verify_data.py pass if anything disagrees. Simulation only: nothing submits orders to Kalshi and no API key exists anywhere in the project.
flags: Newly added this pass: HeatConfirm, a weather rule discovered in a third-party Reddit backtest post, is traded forward precisely because its backtest claim is someone else's — the repository labels the source discovery-only and never a price source, and testing the claim forward IS the experiment.

The desk quantifies its own cron reliability rather than assuming it: IRR-34 (2026-09-21) records scripts/audit_season.py counting every scheduled :07/:37 UTC slot against committed cycles, and the committed audit shows 4 cycles with API errors out of 361 evidence-bound ledger events.

statement: MasterSite catalogs GEMSDOE — Geologic Mapping Prize Challenge in Science & ML Research; its recorded Pages status is built.

value.description: Evidence-backed site for the DOE GEMS Prize Challenge on DrivenData ($300,000 total prize — $50k initial, $250k final — ending 2026-12-03): predicting geothermal faults in the GeoDAWN region under a distance-weighted Tversky metric, with a 19-band feature stack. Session-19 status read from STATUS.md: all four block-holdout folds are now committed and the memorisation-vs-transfer gap is reported as a spread rather than a point — fold 0 +0.0114, fold 1 −0.0070, fold 2 +0.0139, fold 3 +0.0093, mean +0.006904, spread 0.020935, positive in 3 of 4 — and because no fold reaches the ≥12 resampling units a readable block-bootstrap interval needs, the scorer itself flags every per-fold interval `interval_readable: false`, so the honest reading is 'no clear memorisation, no clear transfer gain' with the full-grid 0.099859 (reproduced digit-for-digit on a runner) retained as the selection statistic. The pseudo-label contrast is measured on every committed truth population and points in opposite directions on the two components, but it has now FIRED TWICE and STATUS.md is explicit that 'quoting either one alone would overstate the precision'. The first fire gave held-out blocks 0.0806 → 0.1841 (+0.1036, P=0.999) on the new-fault-like proxy against 0.2113 → 0.1239 (−0.0874, P=0.001) on catalogue labels, deriving TRADE_OFF_PROXY_GAINS_CATALOGUE_LOSSES; the second fire — same seed, same config, same partition, different runner — measured proxy +0.0677 and catalogue −0.1079, deriving GAIN_ON_THE_COMBINED_SURROGATE. That is a ~0.036 run-to-run swing on the proxy arm, the same order of magnitude as the +0.0313 union contrast itself, and the two scopes disagree in sign on the union (+0.0313 held-out against −0.0375 trained-on), which STATUS.md calls instability rather than a result. Read against the bar its own FIELD rule uses (paired block bootstrap P ≥ 0.95), the union contrast reaches P = 0.916 with an interval spanning zero on 8 scoreable blocks, so it is suggestive and not established; both fires' numbers remain in git history but the second overwrote the first's committed evidence files. Both verdicts carry `shippable_evidence: false`, and the circularity is derived rather than asserted, because the pseudo-label path is the same proxy_catalogue.tif the proxy truth is cut from. STATUS.md also defuses one coincidence on purpose: the baseline's union held-out DTI of 0.197183 resembles the public leaderboard's top score of 0.1972, and the two are unrelated quantities. A third population, the disjoint 122,652-pixel union (60,988 + 61,664, disjointness verified at score time), scores the shipped artifact 0.207431 CI95 [0.192924, 0.222879] and puts the adopted emission policy 2nd of 10 distinct emissions (50 swept, 40 pruned as duplicates) — the 1-pixel widening that beats it scores +0.0054 at P=0.815, below both pre-registered bars (P ≥ 0.95 and +0.010), so the adopted policy holds on a third population too, while the union arm that landed as run 35477119490 is recorded as suggestive, under-powered and not shippable. Session 18's pre-registered FIELD-selection rule (docs/FIELD_SELECTION_RULE.md), machine-gated first in reblend.yml, still returns KEEP mean12. Session 21 (2026-09-21) closed the standing data-placement blocker inside a sandbox: scripts/assemble_data_bridge.py reassembled all three official rasters from committed parts in 2.8 s, verifying every part sha256 and each whole-file sha256 against data/bridge/manifest.json (training_features.tif 418,912,844 B, labels.tif 425,830 B, sample_submission.tif 1,599,597 B), after which prepare_data.py PASSED on the placed bytes (3292x3730, 19 bands, EPSG:32611, 100 m, aligned bounds, band tags present). The CPU-only route to a submission was then re-executed end to end and reproduced the committed artifact byte for byte — the same selected policy (floor 0.000974, thin, width 0 px, union DTI 0.160259 on selection fold 0) and a submission.tif whose sha256 matches the committed baseline, with the generalisation audit re-scoring untouched fold 1 at catalogue 0.06597 / proxy 0.071107 / combined 0.078916, reproduced=True and max absolute delta 0.00016874; the two reports differ only in timings. validate_submission.py passed all 8 checks on the freshly written file, and the pre-registered support cap did its job visibly by excluding the highest-scoring candidate (floor 0.009487, union 0.197198) for emitting 487,813 px, 9.4% of the footprint, with the reason printed in the report. The submission subpage's claims were re-read line by line against the official problem description and competition home and hold.

GitHub has not recomputed it since despite roughly 180,000 lines of new JSON evidence landing in session 19, which is the asynchronous-`size` behaviour IRR-04 to IRR-06 describe.

The README warns that its own earlier text is partly superseded (the feature stack is 19 bands, not ~10) and that STATUS.md and the generated site take precedence — this description is therefore sourced from STATUS.md, not the README body.

statement: MasterSite catalogs KalshiPaperSim — Paper-Trading Competition Lab in Markets & Trading Research; its recorded Pages status is built.

value.description: Paper-trading competition platform for Kalshi prediction markets built on real captured Kalshi data — real markets, quotes, order-book depth, candlesticks, the real quadratic fee formula and the real reciprocal YES/NO pricing rule — scored by a deterministic replay engine. Quoted from the repository's own AUTO:COUNTS block (regenerated by scripts/render-docs.js), read 2026-09-21: 111 verified facts (37 documented, 43 captured from production, 1 negative/404 evidence, 25 derived by arithmetic, 5 unexplained observations), 59 flagged irregularities, 51 strategies, 9 real markets, 13,054 captured daily candlesticks across 115 replayable markets (2025-08-17 to 2026-09-21, 12,918 added by the daily ingest), 138 automated tests, and 19 Live Desk entrants on 80 real open contracts with captured ladders (28 paper fills, $2367.9663 official fees, 13-point desk audit passing). The replay leaderboard now ranks 32 entries from $100,000 starting capital, of which 6 finished ahead of it; the four strategies added this pass are FOMC_ProbabilitySniper, GridMM_MultiTier (a multi-level AMM liquidity grid), InsiderFiling_Drift and TheLeap_BreakoutRank, and a fifth, NCAAF_GameFavourite, is deliberately left UNRANKED because no KXNCAAFGAME, KXNCAAFSPREAD or KXNCAAFTOTAL market exists in this flight's universe — LEADERBOARD_QUALIFICATION excludes it rather than list a design that never traded at '0 percent' as though that were a competitive result. Captured store growth since the previous read: hourly 383 markets across 53 series with 225 finalized on the exchange's own result and 20,284 numeric closes, micro 277 markets across 45 series with 139 finalized and 4,179 closes, and 1,501 hourly periods across 366 markets. The repository also maintains an explicit signal-source ledger that reviews this directory: 'the MasterSite review' read the owner's master directory of verified GitHub Pages sites site by site on 2026-09-18 against one question — could this project supply a verified, point-in-time signal a Kalshi strategy could trade on — recording every entry in src/signal-sources.js with a testability verdict and rendering it in the site's Research tab. Its verdicts include SFWeather as a live verified signal (the point-in-time NWS archive feeding ForecastEdge_Weather and WeatherLadder_CheapBands), GOLD as not a market signal because it is a ring buyer's directory, NFLPRED as an empty stub, CEO as not found among the account's public repos, and DrugAnalysis, NBAInjuryReport and Ncaa-football-alerts as mapped to Live Desk entrants trading real open contracts. Each requested source ends in exactly one of three states — a strategy that trades it, a documented blocker naming the source that would close it, or a verified negative — and the ledger states that nothing in it is inferred from a model's memory.
flags: Its headline counters are machine-regenerated and move on almost every commit, so any quoted figure has a short shelf life. This is the third consecutive audit at which AUTO:COUNTS had moved: 101 to 104 verified facts, 43 to 48 strategies, 125 to 128 automated tests, 15 to 18 Live Desk entrants, 21 to 22 paper fills, $2843.0003 to $2394.5289 in official fees, and a leaderboard re-ranked from 28 to 32 entries (IRR-34, IRR-58). The counts above were read at commit f37eeaa and are already liable to be superseded.

Paper trading only, on captured data: no order is ever submitted to Kalshi. The Live Desk trades real OPEN contracts priced from captured ladders, but fills are simulated, and the replay flights are historical. A strategy's rank here is not a claim about live execution.

It grades its own leaderboard honestly. NCAAF_GameFavourite is excluded from ranking entirely rather than shown at 0 percent, on the stated ground that listing a design which never traded would present it as a competitive result — and the table's own reading note says only 6 of 32 ranked entries finished ahead of their starting capital.

Maintains a ledger that audits THIS directory (src/signal-sources.js, reviewed 2026-09-18), including a claim at its Irregularity #42 that this directory's StockPaperSim record was stale. That was true on 2026-09-18 and was corrected here in the 2026-09-20 audit (IRR-37, Season 2 roster 14 to 19), so the flag is itself now out of date; StockPaperSim was re-read and re-stamped here, then moved again to 560efa8 within nine minutes (IRR-61), so its #42 flag is now two states out of date. value.description: Auditable MLB research and paper-betting platform running the loop research -> discover -> verify -> model -> backtest -> forward-test -> paper trade -> analyze -> improve, with no bookmaker, exchange or order-placement client anywhere in the repository. It separates REG, POST, WC, DS, LCS and WS environments (ALL is a roll-up view, not a blended score), carries 68 versioned strategy hypotheses with immutable strategy and model version records, and keeps an append-only SHA-256 hash-chained ledger protected by SQLite UPDATE and DELETE triggers. A source snapshot has now been loaded via content-addressed api.github.com git-blob fetches, taking the repository from its earlier NO_SOURCE_SNAPSHOT state to SOURCE_SNAPSHOT: 28,072 tracked games of which 27,972 are completed, 144,098 ledger records and 441 upcoming bets. Its defining behaviour survives that change intact — settled_bets is still 0 and total_simulated_pnl is still null, because the backtest gate requires a verified timestamped quote before anything can be staked, so the 144,098 records resolve to 118,214 EVAL (calibration only) and 25,884 PROPOSED rather than to profit. The odds source it did find is recorded as PARTIALLY_VERIFIED and marked ineligible for paper PnL specifically because it carries no observed_at, available_at or closing_flag field. All 18 adversarial audit controls pass.

statement: MasterSite catalogs MLB Rain Delay — Live Scoreboard with Weather & Delay Tracking in Sports Data & Scoreboards; its recorded Pages status is built.

value.description: Zero-dependency static MLB scoreboard that adds, for every game on a date's slate, the official weather picture at the ballpark and a verified record of every delay, postponement and suspension. Three pages (index.html scoreboard, delays.html all-games delay feed, game.html single game) read the MLB StatsAPI for status, gameInfo.delayDurationMinutes, play-by-play game_advisory events and box-score info labels, and the US National Weather Service (points -> hourly forecast -> active alerts) for weather, falling back to Environment and Climate Change Canada for Rogers Centre and to Open-Meteo elsewhere (always flagged non-government-source). Delay rows are produced only from official MLB status data, never from a forecast; the derived forecast-risk chip prints its own six thresholds (HIGH/MODERATE/LOW/NONE/COVERED/UNKNOWN) verbatim from RISK_RULES in assets/js/weather.js. A captured copy of the full GET /api/v1/gameStatus registry holds 210 status rows, and three offline Node test suites assert 56 checks in total (26 delays, 24 weather, 6 render).
flags: Repository logs its own irregularities rather than resolving them silently: docs/verification.md sections 8 and 9.2 record four live findings from the 2026-09-21 pass (gameStatus N-family row reorder with identical 210-row membership, the registry endpoint ignoring fields=, fields= combined with hydrate= returning empty hydrated objects, and live box scores carrying more info[] labels than the captured fixture), plus six bugs found and fixed in section 9.3.

By design it does not scan Twitter/X, Facebook, Instagram, Reddit or news sites — the repository states a keyless static page has no verifiable way to read them — and instead links official club news, @MLB_PR, NWS and SPC pages under a Manual review heading. Its own Limitations section also records that browser CORS for the Environment Canada endpoint is still unverified and that some special-event venues have no coordinates.
Created 2026-09-21T02:00:24Z, the youngest entry in this directory, and pushed to three times on its first day — treat every count in this description as a point-in-time read.

value.description: Autonomous NBA betting-strategy research and paper-trading competition lab that cross-verifies real public data, turns public claims into testable hypotheses, backtests them against verified historical prices where those exist and forward-tests them where they do not. It runs 22 system-generated strategies with a $1,000 virtual bankroll each over a competition window of 2026-09-20 to 2027-09-19, staking at 25% Kelly capped at 3% per bet, collecting ESPN schedule, scores and current odds, the ESPN injury board, Kalshi public market data and NBA.com/stats team and player logs, and modeling chronological Elo (MOV-adjusted, with season carryover), rolling pace and efficiency totals and rest, back-to-back, road-trip and time-zone features. Signal-quality results are published as signal quality and never mixed into backtest or forward PnL records. As of the generated leaderboard at 2026-09-21T19:58:05Z the competition has genuinely not started: all 22 forward entries read status 'awaiting-opportunity' with 0 bets and a null win rate, and all 22 backtest entries read 'no historical data' — the platform reports the absence rather than a zero. Paper trading only; no real money.

value.description: A deliberately small, evidence-first betting-research workbench whose central finding is that none of its strategies beat the market on the pilot sample. Football pilot: a 27-match Bundesliga 1 2024/25 sample (matchdays 1, 10 and 20, fixtures committed and sha256-verified) reached 27/27 dual-source result agreement between OpenLigaDB and football-data.co.uk on an exact-minute UK-time join, yielding 613 odds snapshots (405 on 1X2 plus 208 on a newly added over/under 2.5 goals market) across 9 strategies — all nine negative on both markets, with confidence intervals including zero and a Holm-adjusted p of 1.0. Sport two is ice hockey (DEL 2024/25) on the same open-licensed OpenLigaDB path, with overtime- and shootout-aware final-score selection and one Elo strategy that produces predictions only: 11 graded predictions, 7 correct (63.6%), Brier 0.4737, and PnL reported as unavailable rather than zero because no permissioned odds path exists for hockey. Sport three is darts (PDC), prediction-only, where the cold 2025 pool made 0 selections in 141 opportunities because the maximum probability of 0.551 never cleared the 0.60 threshold — recorded as silence with no refit — while the full 2025-26 pool graded 39 of 48 correct (81.25%) at Brier 0.349. Identity is labelled per sport: football verified, hockey and darts probable on a single source. 258 offline pytest tests cover fixtures, odds parsing, time-zone handling, settlement, walk-forward invariants and each pilot's guarantees, and every number carries a licence and a retrieval date with the ODbL attribution for OpenLigaDB stated on the site itself.

statement: MasterSite catalogs ShoulderPain — Research-Backed Shoulder & Scapula Pain Guide in Health & Personal Guides; its recorded Pages status is built.

value.description: Source-linked GitHub Pages guide to shoulder and shoulder-blade ('wing') pain, written around one stated context — a male adult aged about 36-40, left-side sleeping, a possible workout injury, prolonged computer use and limited room space — and explicitly educational information rather than a diagnosis or a personalised rehabilitation plan, with emergency and urgent warning signs given priority over exercises, furniture or symptom logging. Ten pages share one static template and compact navigation: start, medical advice, treatment, exercises, desk and room, furniture and prices, care costs, an optional log, sources and audit, and next steps; all research content works without JavaScript and no sign-in or symptom entry is required. The current revision is a deliberate narrowing rather than an expansion. It reviewed the pre-existing site at commit e1c63c4 and, in its own words, 'replaces blanket verification/completeness claims with a narrower, auditable source register, simplifies the UI and corrects unsafe or unverified assumptions', keeping the previous site in Git history. Twenty official pages were opened directly on 2026-09-20 — MedlinePlus, NHS, AAOS/ASES, CSP, OSHA, CMS, five furniture manufacturers or sellers, and Luna — and data/sources.json records each source's section, a short excerpt, its scope and its check date, with government and medical-society guidance kept separate from commercial product information. data/claims.json maps source-bearing content units to references and source-file lines: 90 review units, described as a review aid and 'not an automated truth certificate'. Exercises were reduced to four source-checked examples carrying exact AAOS HTML doses and supervision boundaries. Five furniture listings give exact variant and price boundaries with folding trade-offs, and no product is claimed to fit an unmeasured room or to treat shoulder pain; the one care price quoted is an official provider example ($135 self-pay per visit at Luna), not a nationwide average, and other unverified medical costs are explicitly left unpriced. REVIEW.md documents three passes and eight source irregularities found while reading, including a COMHOMA price where $54.49 was the selected White variant and $25.50 the discount, a VIVO desk that folds against the wall but is not quickly detached, a Lillipad whose specifications claim a 700 lb static test while its FAQ says 350 lb and neither replaces the 75 lb operational rating, and a Luna search excerpt showing $125 where both directly opened pages showed $135. The optional log is local-only, retains the `shoulderpain-log-v1` key so prior entries can still be read or imported if valid, and validates numbers, booleans, calendar dates and shape; invalid entries are counted and never rounded or silently converted, invalid persisted data blocks edits rather than being overwritten, raw JSON export is available for recovery, cross-tab changes block saves until reload, spreadsheet formula injection is mitigated on CSV export, and the bounded import size was raised to 20 MB so the 5,000-entry schema can import its own backups. Its former clinical 'improving/worsening' classifier and calendar-based advice were removed on the grounds that sparse logs should not reassure someone or postpone assessment, and the summary is now descriptive only. Validation reports 8 Node unit tests and 31 Chromium browser tests passing, automated axe WCAG 2 A/AA and 2.1 AA checks passing on all ten pages at 390px and 1440px, and no page-level horizontal overflow at 320, 390, 768 or 1440px. Sources retrieved 2026-09-20.
flags: Its own verification policy refuses the strongest claims a directory reader might assume: 'Unknown or conflicting facts stay visibly unresolved. No claim of independent clinical verification or zero errors', and 'Automated checks cannot establish medical accuracy'. REVIEW.md adds that no clinician independently reviewed the personalised suitability of the information, and that link integrity, automated accessibility and browser tests are not medical validation.

Deliberately narrower than the version it replaced. The prior revision carried a 56-source register (S1-S56), four logged review passes, 32 logged corrections and a 32-row irregularity table; this one carries 20 opened sources, three passes, 8 source irregularities and a 6-row next-steps table. Its stated reason is worth quoting because it is the opposite of the usual instinct: 'The guide is a focused, source-linked starting set, not all possible diseases or products. Further expansion should improve evidence rather than inflate a count' (IRR-57).

Now has a build and test step, unlike the version previously described here: npm ci, npm run build (claim ledger plus ten static root HTML pages), npm run check, npm test, npm run test:browser (Playwright) and npm run serve, with the shared page layout in tools/build.py and Python 3 and Node 22 used in validation. Visitors need neither. Committed root HTML means the Pages configuration needs no runtime build.

Browser tests were run against an npm-distributed Chromium 153 binary extracted outside Git because the standard Playwright browser download and Debian package retrieval were blocked by sandbox networking; REVIEW.md states plainly that 'this is not an unexecuted test claim', and CI uses the normal Playwright installation on GitHub-hosted runners. Remaining testing limits it names: no manual screen-reader-user audit, no cross-browser matrix, no third-party video-playback test, and automated accessibility is not full conformance certification.

Open limitations it lists for a next session: no clinician exam or clinical peer review and no systematic literature review; actual room fit, safe removal route and body/desk measurements unknown; no checked chair meets both the folding and the adjustable long-day-workstation criteria; product stock, prices and return policies change and Lillipad has contradictory page content; personal care and medicine costs, country and insurance remain unknown.

statement: MasterSite catalogs StockPaperSim — Persona Paper-Trading Competition (Replay + Live Book) in Markets & Trading Research; its recorded Pages status is built.

value.description: One-year paper-trading competition between return-seeking strategy personas, with a real venue model (depth, spreads, market making, dated tick sizes and fees), a full audit trail and a dependency-free static site. The repository documents three runs, re-read 2026-09-20 at its fourth pass: Season 1 with 20 personas replaying the real S&P 500 and VIX path (republished with its numbers re-derived rather than patched), the legacy Live Book with 19 personas trading forward from official free series (Nasdaq Composite, Dow Jones, S&P 500, VIX, SOFR and four macro series), and Season 2 with 19 personas in a reproducible research replay on collected daily bars — the Season 2 roster having grown from 14 to 19 with three new slate personas (NFL, NBA, NCAA) and two forward-only probes, while the landed complete ESPN NBA scoreboard (1,330 rows, 2025-10-21 to 2026-06-14) lets the NBA slate persona trade the full 2025-26 season. The fourth pass is the arrival of real SEC Form 4 insider data through an agent lane: a rendered-extraction campaign collected 65 filings and 99 parsed transactions across all ten tracked tickers (AAPL, MSFT, NVDA, JPM, XOM, JNJ, PG, TSLA, MU, T), every filing dated on or after 2026-06-01, captured as the SEC's own XSL-rendered Form 4 views plus filing indexes through the page-fetch route into data/real/sec_agent/, whose 131-entry staged_manifest.json has every file SHA-256 digested and re-verified at staging. sim/edgar_rendered.py parses those captures fail-closed — handling footnoted codes and prices, dual and triple checkbox roles and 10b5-1 plan flags — and scripts/stage_sec_rendered.py integrates the lane into the same JSONL the walk and bulk sets feed, de-duplicated on (accession, date, ticker, code, shares, price). Eleven filings parse to no Table I trade rows because they are derivative-only DSU/RSU grants or balance-only rows, and are flagged rather than dropped silently. The gaps are recorded rather than hidden: two MU filings exceeded the page-fetch size budget and were excluded, and the window contains zero code-P open-market purchases, so the buy-side insider signals register as NO-OBSERVATIONS and @InsiderCluster_Live reports READY-NO-OBSERVATIONS — ready and reading real filings but placing no intents until purchases land. The quarterly structured bulk sets remain refused to the collection runner (HTTP 403 / rate gate, limitation L-27), so this is a complementary rendered lane, not a replacement. The suite is 648 tests green, the official audit report adds 1,871 checks, and the committed registers hold 78 irregularities and 44 limitations. It states plainly that the executable bars are collected Yahoo Finance files marked SECONDARY, that two of seventeen price series in Season 1 are real observations while the other fifteen are labelled simulations, and that the committed-price run is not eligible as an official-price competition. Sources retrieved 2026-09-20. A clean front-door hub was added at the repository root this pass and docs/ was regenerated from the current generator to close a stale-site gate.

statement: MasterSite catalogs Commodities — Kalshi Research Exchange in Markets & Trading Research; its recorded Pages status is built.

value.description: Evidence-first paper-trading lab for Kalshi event contracts, organised around an automated forward-test desk. 23 return-seeking strategy personas (plus 4 gated ones) trade open Kalshi contracts on paper twice an hour from a scheduled, read-only GitHub Actions collector, and every fill, exit, settlement, intent, mark and order book is committed back to the repository. Two backtests run on verified official Kalshi price data: the original hand-collected sample (3 settled markets, 130 verified bars, 5 personas), deliberately frozen, and an archive backtest replayed bar by bar over the candle archive the collector now stores (45 markets, 1,691 verified bars, 199 trades, 9 rule sets, with per-trade equity curves and a walk-forward stability split). An execution-realism check re-reads every simulated fill against Kalshi's own published trade tape via GET /markets/trades and reports the difference in cents, with a committed live result of 158 fills compared at a median absolute desk-minus-tape gap of 1.00 cent. A season health audit (scripts/audit_season.py) checks the schedule, ledger coverage, storage compaction, signal adapters and the tape summary, re-reads settled markets against the official API on the runner, and refuses to let verify_data.py pass if anything disagrees. Simulation only: nothing submits orders to Kalshi and no API key exists anywhere in the project.

statement: MasterSite catalogs GEMSDOE — Geologic Mapping Prize Challenge in Science & ML Research; its recorded Pages status is built.

value.description: Evidence-backed site for the DOE GEMS Prize Challenge on DrivenData ($300,000 total prize — $50k initial, $250k final — ending 2026-12-03): predicting geothermal faults in the GeoDAWN region under a distance-weighted Tversky metric, with a 19-band feature stack. Session-19 status read from STATUS.md: all four block-holdout folds are now committed and the memorisation-vs-transfer gap is reported as a spread rather than a point — fold 0 +0.0114, fold 1 −0.0070, fold 2 +0.0139, fold 3 +0.0093, mean +0.006904, spread 0.020935, positive in 3 of 4 — and because no fold reaches the ≥12 resampling units a readable block-bootstrap interval needs, the scorer itself flags every per-fold interval `interval_readable: false`, so the honest reading is 'no clear memorisation, no clear transfer gain' with the full-grid 0.099859 (reproduced digit-for-digit on a runner) retained as the selection statistic. The pseudo-label contrast is measured on every committed truth population and points in opposite directions on the two components, but it has now FIRED TWICE and STATUS.md is explicit that 'quoting either one alone would overstate the precision'. The first fire gave held-out blocks 0.0806 → 0.1841 (+0.1036, P=0.999) on the new-fault-like proxy against 0.2113 → 0.1239 (−0.0874, P=0.001) on catalogue labels, deriving TRADE_OFF_PROXY_GAINS_CATALOGUE_LOSSES; the second fire — same seed, same config, same partition, different runner — measured proxy +0.0677 and catalogue −0.1079, deriving GAIN_ON_THE_COMBINED_SURROGATE. That is a ~0.036 run-to-run swing on the proxy arm, the same order of magnitude as the +0.0313 union contrast itself, and the two scopes disagree in sign on the union (+0.0313 held-out against −0.0375 trained-on), which STATUS.md calls instability rather than a result. Read against the bar its own FIELD rule uses (paired block bootstrap P ≥ 0.95), the union contrast reaches P = 0.916 with an interval spanning zero on 8 scoreable blocks, so it is suggestive and not established; both fires' numbers remain in git history but the second overwrote the first's committed evidence files. Both verdicts carry `shippable_evidence: false`, and the circularity is derived rather than asserted, because the pseudo-label path is the same proxy_catalogue.tif the proxy truth is cut from. STATUS.md also defuses one coincidence on purpose: the baseline's union held-out DTI of 0.197183 resembles the public leaderboard's top score of 0.1972, and the two are unrelated quantities. A third population, the disjoint 122,652-pixel union (60,988 + 61,664, disjointness verified at score time), scores the shipped artifact 0.207431 CI95 [0.192924, 0.222879] and puts the adopted emission policy 2nd of 10 distinct emissions (50 swept, 40 pruned as duplicates) — the 1-pixel widening that beats it scores +0.0054 at P=0.815, below both pre-registered bars (P ≥ 0.95 and +0.010), so the adopted policy holds on a third population too, while the union arm that landed as run 35477119490 is recorded as suggestive, under-powered and not shippable. Session 18's pre-registered FIELD-selection rule (docs/FIELD_SELECTION_RULE.md), machine-gated first in reblend.yml, still returns KEEP mean12. Session 21 (2026-09-21) closed the standing data-placement blocker inside a sandbox: scripts/assemble_data_bridge.py reassembled all three official rasters from committed parts in 2.8 s, verifying every part sha256 and each whole-file sha256 against data/bridge/manifest.json (training_features.tif 418,912,844 B, labels.tif 425,830 B, sample_submission.tif 1,599,597 B), after which prepare_data.py PASSED on the placed bytes (3292x3730, 19 bands, EPSG:32611, 100 m, aligned bounds, band tags present). The CPU-only route to a submission was then re-executed end to end and reproduced the committed artifact byte for byte — the same selected policy (floor 0.000974, thin, width 0 px, union DTI 0.160259 on selection fold 0) and a submission.tif whose sha256 matches the committed baseline, with the generalisation audit re-scoring untouched fold 1 at catalogue 0.06597 / proxy 0.071107 / combined 0.078916, reproduced=True and max absolute delta 0.00016874; the two reports differ only in timings. validate_submission.py passed all 8 checks on the freshly written file, and the pre-registered support cap did its job visibly by excluding the highest-scoring candidate (floor 0.009487, union 0.197198) for emitting 487,813 px, 9.4% of the footprint, with the reason printed in the report. The submission subpage's claims were re-read line by line against the official problem description and competition home and hold.

Quoted from the repository's own AUTO:COUNTS block (regenerated by scripts/render-docs.js), read 2026-09-21: 111 verified facts (37 documented, 43 captured from production, 1 negative/404 evidence, 25 derived by arithmetic, 5 unexplained observations), 59 flagged irregularities, 51 strategies, 9 real markets, 13,054 captured daily candlesticks across 115 replayable markets (2025-08-17 to 2026-09-21, 12,918 added by the daily ingest), 138 automated tests, and 19 Live Desk entrants on 80 real open contracts with captured ladders (28 paper fills, $2367.9663 official fees, 13-point desk audit passing). The replay leaderboard now ranks 32 entries from $100,000 starting capital, of which 6 finished ahead of it; the four strategies added this pass are FOMC_ProbabilitySniper, GridMM_MultiTier (a multi-level AMM liquidity grid), InsiderFiling_Drift and TheLeap_BreakoutRank, and a fifth, NCAAF_GameFavourite, is deliberately left UNRANKED because no KXNCAAFGAME, KXNCAAFSPREAD or KXNCAAFTOTAL market exists in this flight's universe — LEADERBOARD_QUALIFICATION excludes it rather than list a design that never traded at '0 percent' as though that were a competitive result. value.description: A deliberately small, evidence-first betting-research workbench whose central finding is that none of its strategies beat the market on the pilot sample. Football pilot: a 27-match Bundesliga 1 2024/25 sample (matchdays 1, 10 and 20, fixtures committed and sha256-verified) reached 27/27 dual-source result agreement between OpenLigaDB and football-data.co.uk on an exact-minute UK-time join, yielding 613 odds snapshots (405 on 1X2 plus 208 on a newly added over/under 2.5 goals market) across 9 strategies — all nine negative on both markets, with confidence intervals including zero and a Holm-adjusted p of 1.0. Sport two is ice hockey (DEL 2024/25) on the same open-licensed OpenLigaDB path, with overtime- and shootout-aware final-score selection and one Elo strategy that produces predictions only: 11 graded predictions, 7 correct (63.6%), Brier 0.4737, and PnL reported as unavailable rather than zero because no permissioned odds path exists for hockey. Sport three is darts (PDC), prediction-only, where the cold 2025 pool made 0 selections in 141 opportunities because the maximum probability of 0.551 never cleared the 0.60 threshold — recorded as silence with no refit — while the full 2025-26 pool graded 39 of 48 correct (81.25%) at Brier 0.349. Identity is labelled per sport: football verified, hockey and darts probable on a single source. 258 offline pytest tests cover fixtures, odds parsing, time-zone handling, settlement, walk-forward invariants and each pilot's guarantees, and every number carries a licence and a retrieval date with the ODbL attribution for OpenLigaDB stated on the site itself.

statement: MasterSite catalogs ShoulderPain — Research-Backed Shoulder & Scapula Pain Guide in Health & Personal Guides; its recorded Pages status is built.

value.description: Source-linked GitHub Pages guide to shoulder and shoulder-blade ('wing') pain, written around one stated context — a male adult aged about 36-40, left-side sleeping, a possible workout injury, prolonged computer use and limited room space — and explicitly educational information rather than a diagnosis or a personalised rehabilitation plan, with emergency and urgent warning signs given priority over exercises, furniture or symptom logging. Ten pages share one static template and compact navigation: start, medical advice, treatment, exercises, desk and room, furniture and prices, care costs, an optional log, sources and audit, and next steps; all research content works without JavaScript and no sign-in or symptom entry is required. The current revision is a deliberate narrowing rather than an expansion. It reviewed the pre-existing site at commit e1c63c4 and, in its own words, 'replaces blanket verification/completeness claims with a narrower, auditable source register, simplifies the UI and corrects unsafe or unverified assumptions', keeping the previous site in Git history. Twenty official pages were opened directly on 2026-09-20 — MedlinePlus, NHS, AAOS/ASES, CSP, OSHA, CMS, five furniture manufacturers or sellers, and Luna — and data/sources.json records each source's section, a short excerpt, its scope and its check date, with government and medical-society guidance kept separate from commercial product information. data/claims.json maps source-bearing content units to references and source-file lines: 90 review units, described as a review aid and 'not an automated truth certificate'. Exercises were reduced to four source-checked examples carrying exact AAOS HTML doses and supervision boundaries. Five furniture listings give exact variant and price boundaries with folding trade-offs, and no product is claimed to fit an unmeasured room or to treat shoulder pain; the one care price quoted is an official provider example ($135 self-pay per visit at Luna), not a nationwide average, and other unverified medical costs are explicitly left unpriced. REVIEW.md documents three passes and eight source irregularities found while reading, including a COMHOMA price where $54.49 was the selected White variant and $25.50 the discount, a VIVO desk that folds against the wall but is not quickly detached, a Lillipad whose specifications claim a 700 lb static test while its FAQ says 350 lb and neither replaces the 75 lb operational rating, and a Luna search excerpt showing $125 where both directly opened pages showed $135. The optional log is local-only, retains the `shoulderpain-log-v1` key so prior entries can still be read or imported if valid, and validates numbers, booleans, calendar dates and shape; invalid entries are counted and never rounded or silently converted, invalid persisted data blocks edits rather than being overwritten, raw JSON export is available for recovery, cross-tab changes block saves until reload, spreadsheet formula injection is mitigated on CSV export, and the bounded import size was raised to 20 MB so the 5,000-entry schema can import its own backups. Its former clinical 'improving/worsening' classifier and calendar-based advice were removed on the grounds that sparse logs should not reassure someone or postpone assessment, and the summary is now descriptive only. Validation reports 8 Node unit tests and 31 Chromium browser tests passing, automated axe WCAG 2 A/AA and 2.1 AA checks passing on all ten pages at 390px and 1440px, and no page-level horizontal overflow at 320, 390, 768 or 1440px. Sources retrieved 2026-09-20.
flags: Its own verification policy refuses the strongest claims a directory reader might assume: 'Unknown or conflicting facts stay visibly unresolved. No claim of independent clinical verification or zero errors', and 'Automated checks cannot establish medical accuracy'. REVIEW.md adds that no clinician independently reviewed the personalised suitability of the information, and that link integrity, automated accessibility and browser tests are not medical validation.

Deliberately narrower than the version it replaced. The prior revision carried a 56-source register (S1-S56), four logged review passes, 32 logged corrections and a 32-row irregularity table; this one carries 20 opened sources, three passes, 8 source irregularities and a 6-row next-steps table. Its stated reason is worth quoting because it is the opposite of the usual instinct: 'The guide is a focused, source-linked starting set, not all possible diseases or products. Further expansion should improve evidence rather than inflate a count' (IRR-57).

Now has a build and test step, unlike the version previously described here: npm ci, npm run build (claim ledger plus ten static root HTML pages), npm run check, npm test, npm run test:browser (Playwright) and npm run serve, with the shared page layout in tools/build.py and Python 3 and Node 22 used in validation. Visitors need neither. Committed root HTML means the Pages configuration needs no runtime build.

Browser tests were run against an npm-distributed Chromium 153 binary extracted outside Git because the standard Playwright browser download and Debian package retrieval were blocked by sandbox networking; REVIEW.md states plainly that 'this is not an unexecuted test claim', and CI uses the normal Playwright installation on GitHub-hosted runners. Remaining testing limits it names: no manual screen-reader-user audit, no cross-browser matrix, no third-party video-playback test, and automated accessibility is not full conformance certification.

Open limitations it lists for a next session: no clinician exam or clinical peer review and no systematic literature review; actual room fit, safe removal route and body/desk measurements unknown; no checked chair meets both the folding and the adjustable long-day-workstation criteria; product stock, prices and return policies change and Lillipad has contradictory page content; personal care and medicine costs, country and insurance remain unknown.

Changed state four times inside one audit and this description is the fourth rewrite — verified in sequence against 239eaa8 (01:25:47Z), dd1a7d4 (02:13:17Z), 6812ef3 (02:42:19Z, 60 seconds after a prior stamp had been written) and now 8a21b94 (03:07:51Z), which rebuilt all ten pages and reversed the sourcing method entirely (IRR-47, IRR-57).

Re-verified upstream on 21 September 2026: every medical, exercise and workstation source (M1-M6, E1-E3, W1-W3) was re-opened and all registered excerpts still match the official pages. Product rechecks succeeded only partially — VIVO and Lillipad were re-verified through official seller product-data endpoints, while fetch-proxy failures prevented re-opening IKEA, Branch, three manual/spec PDFs and the cost sources, whose entries stay dated 20 September 2026 and are labelled as such on the site. statement: MasterSite catalogs StockPaperSim — Persona Paper-Trading Competition (Replay + Live Book) in Markets & Trading Research; its recorded Pages status is built.

value.description: One-year paper-trading competition between return-seeking strategy personas, with a real venue model (depth, spreads, market making, dated tick sizes and fees), a full audit trail and a dependency-free static site. The repository documents three runs, re-read 2026-09-20 at its fourth pass: Season 1 with 20 personas replaying the real S&P 500 and VIX path (republished with its numbers re-derived rather than patched), the legacy Live Book with 19 personas trading forward from official free series (Nasdaq Composite, Dow Jones, S&P 500, VIX, SOFR and four macro series), and Season 2 with 19 personas in a reproducible research replay on collected daily bars — the Season 2 roster having grown from 14 to 19 with three new slate personas (NFL, NBA, NCAA) and two forward-only probes, while the landed complete ESPN NBA scoreboard (1,330 rows, 2025-10-21 to 2026-06-14) lets the NBA slate persona trade the full 2025-26 season. The fourth pass is the arrival of real SEC Form 4 insider data through an agent lane: a rendered-extraction campaign collected 65 filings and 99 parsed transactions across all ten tracked tickers (AAPL, MSFT, NVDA, JPM, XOM, JNJ, PG, TSLA, MU, T), every filing dated on or after 2026-06-01, captured as the SEC's own XSL-rendered Form 4 views plus filing indexes through the page-fetch route into data/real/sec_agent/, whose 131-entry staged_manifest.json has every file SHA-256 digested and re-verified at staging. sim/edgar_rendered.py parses those captures fail-closed — handling footnoted codes and prices, dual and triple checkbox roles and 10b5-1 plan flags — and scripts/stage_sec_rendered.py integrates the lane into the same JSONL the walk and bulk sets feed, de-duplicated on (accession, date, ticker, code, shares, price). Eleven filings parse to no Table I trade rows because they are derivative-only DSU/RSU grants or balance-only rows, and are flagged rather than dropped silently. The gaps are recorded rather than hidden: two MU filings exceeded the page-fetch size budget and were excluded, and the window contains zero code-P open-market purchases, so the buy-side insider signals register as NO-OBSERVATIONS and @InsiderCluster_Live reports READY-NO-OBSERVATIONS — ready and reading real filings but placing no intents until purchases land. The quarterly structured bulk sets remain refused to the collection runner (HTTP 403 / rate gate, limitation L-27), so this is a complementary rendered lane, not a replacement. The suite is 648 tests green, the official audit report adds 1,871 checks, and the committed registers hold 78 irregularities and 44 limitations. It states plainly that the executable bars are collected Yahoo Finance files marked SECONDARY, that two of seventeen price series in Season 1 are real observations while the other fifteen are labelled simulations, and that the committed-price run is not eligible as an official-price competition. Sources retrieved 2026-09-20. A clean front-door hub was added at the repository root this pass and docs/ was regenerated from the current generator to close a stale-site gate.
flags: GitHub Pages is configured to publish the repository root, not /docs, so a root index.html redirects to docs/index.html; the repository notes that changing the Pages source needs admin rights (the API returns 403 for its CI token), which is why the redirect is still in every visitor's path (IRR-43).

Its insider signal is ready but has nothing to trade on. The extracted Form 4 window contains zero code-P open-market purchases, so @InsiderCluster_Live reports READY-NO-OBSERVATIONS and the insider participants hold no positions and say why, rather than substituting an aggregator for a filing or showing an empty result as a neutral one. Two MU filings were excluded for exceeding the page-fetch size budget, and 11 of the 65 parse to no Table I trade rows — all flagged, none dropped silently.

Data provenance is labelled rather than smoothed: the executable bars are collected Yahoo Finance files marked SECONDARY, only two of seventeen Season 1 price series are real observations with the other fifteen labelled simulations, and the committed-price run is explicitly not eligible as an official-price competition. The SEC quarterly structured bulk sets are still refused to its runner (HTTP 403 / rate gate, L-27).

Fast-moving repository: a single-commit README-only placeholder in the 2026-09-17 audit, it needed description rewrites in each audit since — the Season 2 roster went 14 to 19 personas (IRR-37), then the fourth pass landed the SEC Form 4 agent lane and moved tests 634 to 648, audit checks 1,870 to 1,871 and LIMITATIONS.json 43 to 44 (IRR-61). KalshiPaperSim's signal-source ledger flagged this directory's StockPaperSim record as stale at its irregularity #42 on 2026-09-18; that was corrected here on 2026-09-20 and the repository has since moved twice more (IRR-60).

statement: MasterSite catalogs The Leap — Verified Research & Instrument Intelligence in Markets & Trading Research; its recorded Pages status is built.

value.description: Reproducible research layer for TradingView's The Leap paper-trading competition (AMP Futures, Sep 2026) that separates official contest facts, historical champion outcomes, vendor-sourced market moves, capacity arithmetic and independently simulated strategy verdicts — and never presents a backtest as a platform result. Its 2026-09-20 audit banner reports that the volatile-stock matrix is now COMPLETE: 60/60 series captured (20 x 15m + 20 x 1h + 20 x 1d) through a CI capture lane with byte-level SHA-256 provenance, recorded in data/intraday_index.json, up from the 37/60 partial pool (16 x 15m, 10 x 1h, 11 x 1d) reported two days earlier. Full-pool verdicts were assigned at 60/60: H34 and H37 partially supported, H36 supported, H35 and H38 refuted, H39 (C19) and H41 (C22) inconclusive on zero fire; the pre-registered gate then fired and the new variant C19-A was registered as H42, also zero-fire and therefore inconclusive on its first full-pool run. The banner is equally explicit about what the captures are not: they are Yahoo vendor-tier, not exchange-verified; the Alpaca IEX route (`make official-bars`) remains blocked on environment credentials; and no authenticated TradingView Strategy Report export is available. The body's latest pass section is still the September 19 sixteenth pass, whose verified facts are unchanged: the tenth official frontier capture (R10, N=99,663) recorded the edition's first rank-1 turnover, with HappyLittleTrades promoted from #3 to rank 1 at +994.30 percent / $2,485,745.50 and youcanttrickme falling to #4 at +908.01 percent / $2,270,023.00, and ranks 1-250 fully re-enumerated into committed evidence; the rules were re-verified line by line with 94/94 symbols, caps and listing order identical and 0 equity instruments; all 15 completed-edition champion records were re-read verbatim with 0 mismatch, the maximum being 53.2072x, so no 100x appears in verified history; the $50,000 cash ARV prize ladder is unchanged; and the frozen model roster grew 32 to 38 with C17 (overnight implosion harvester), C18 (blow-off short avalanche) and C19 (twin-hammer capitulation compounder) added alongside hypotheses H37-H39, daily usernames 28 to 34. Verification at that pass ran 401 passed / 0 failed / 1 warning, a 459-check self-test and 94 unit tests. One text change was found in the rules and flagged rather than silently adopted: the payment rail moved from 'at least $1000 wire-or-PayPal' to 'at least $600 wire-only' (IR-29, low), with the payout configuration left frozen at the $1000 reading. Placement arithmetic still holds that matching rank 50 from a fresh $250,000 account needs +15.99 percent per day compounded, unbroken. Sources retrieved 2026-09-20. Since that banner the pool has moved again: a nineteenth contrarian model, C23 (serial capitulation snapback), was pre-registered as H43 after a documented pre-freeze probe of 75 eight-streaks pool-wide and was refuted on its first full-pool run — both usernames beat the control over 81 season editions, but the forward held-out split missed by $20.56. CME product hours for all 20 pooled futures are now committed with a 196-date roll schedule (18 codecs, 2 refusals). Captures remain Yahoo vendor-tier rather than exchange-verified: the Alpaca IEX route stays blocked on environment credentials, and the repository states plainly that no figure on the site is claimed to come from a real TradingView Strategy result.
flags: Its own banner states the limit plainly: captures are Yahoo vendor-tier, NOT exchange-verified, official intraday acquisition is credential-blocked, the Alpaca IEX route needs authorized environment credentials, and no authenticated TradingView Strategy Report export exists. 'Do not treat historical candidates as current orders.'

The README's header banner and its body are out of step. The banner is dated 2026-09-20 and reports the completed 60/60 matrix, models C22 and C19-A and hypotheses H41 and H42, but those identifiers appear nowhere else in the document — the newest body section is still 'September 19 sixteenth pass', whose roster is 32 to 38 with C17-C19 and H37-H39, and whose audit banner note still describes the 37/60 partial pool. A reader taking the roster count or the verdict list from the body gets the previous state (IRR-59).

Most full-pool verdicts are negative or non-results rather than wins: H35 and H38 refuted, H34 and H37 only partially supported, and H39, H41 and H42 inconclusive because their models never fired on the full pool. A zero-fire model is reported as inconclusive, not as a pass.

Contest facts are re-verified rather than remembered, and discrepancies are registered instead of smoothed: the landing hero count (99,658) trails the contest count (99,663) by the usual async lag (IR-09), and the payment-rail text change is flagged as IR-29 with the payout config deliberately left at the older reading.
Read at commit 6d8f0ef, its fourth move inside two audits; the previous three were recorded at IRR-36 when the description was rewritten from R9 (96,707 participants) to R10 (99,663).

statement: MasterSite catalogs VacationSchedule — Free Time Scoreboard (SF Radio Blackout Calendar) in Sports Data & Scoreboards; its recorded Pages status is built.

value.description: Bay Area vacation planner comparing three definitions of sports-free time in 2026-2029 for a listener in San Francisco ZIP 94122, with one-, two- and three-week trip checks, a daily scoreboard, a month calendar, Pacific-time free intervals, sources and a review queue. The three sections nest: Section 1 counts all 30 MLB clubs plus 49ers preseason, regular season and postseason and the Westwood One national NFL feeds as busy; Section 2 adds Stanford and California football; Section 3 adds San Jose Earthquakes MLS. An 'Everything tracked' option adds national NCAA football plus Golden State Warriors and Golden State Valkyries on KGMZ 95.7 The Game. Only AM/FM broadcasts count, so the San Jose Sharks (app/streaming only) and Audacy-app-only Valkyries games are disclosed exclusions, and USF basketball, Westwood One NCAA basketball and local college basketball are named as documented gaps rather than silently treated as free time. With Spring Training excluded, Sections 1 and 2 give longest modeled windows of 44 days in 2026 (Feb 9 - Mar 24, past), 37 in 2027 (Feb 15 - Mar 23), 40 in 2028 (estimated) and 41 in 2029 (estimated); with Spring Training included no section reaches two weeks. The repository refuses a blanket verified claim: TBD kickoff reserves the entire local date including DST 23- and 25-hour days, 'no known conflict' is stated to describe the snapshot rather than certify a quiet day, and all times are America/Los_Angeles rather than a fixed UTC-8 offset. A 2026-09-21 session-3 pass added two tabs: MLB 2026 & 2027, listing every fixture the league has scheduled for all 30 clubs from the committed Stats API snapshot with each row carrying the league's own game_pk, and Postseason 2026, which splits the postseason into what is resolved and what is not — clinched berths and division titles, official round dates, dates that cannot carry a game, and a machine-measured count of published first pitches, still zero. The fixture lists are produced on a GitHub runner by scripts/export_mlb_schedule.py, validated for all 30 clubs, a plausible regular-season count and unique game ids, and committed with a provenance summary recording the exact request URL, the retrieval time and a SHA-256 of the raw response, so every row is re-verifiable by hand. Where a season snapshot exists the analysis blocks real fixture dates rather than a continuous season frame.
flags: Substantially rewritten upstream between 2026-09-20 and 2026-09-21 (13 commits, 'Rebuild site as a clean, table-first vacation decision engine'). The previously published description — 11-day best window, 42 tests, 53 review items, 21 irregularities in docs/IRREGULARITIES.md — no longer matches the repository and has been replaced wholesale rather than patched (IRR-66).

Classification changed stub -> app: the Pages workflow publishes site/ via Actions, and the repository also commits a root index.html that forwards to site/ so the legacy main/root Pages setting keeps working. tools/audit_kind.py now reports main//index.html HTTP 200, resolving the earlier IRR-43-class finding.

Coverage is explicitly partial and the repository says so: the 2026-09-21 pass re-verified Westwood One rows, MLB clinch facts, Super Bowl dates and the 49ers per-game radio stations, but college and MLS fixtures remain inherited snapshots, and 53 postseason records still have no published start time.

value.description: Evidence-first paper-trading lab for Kalshi event contracts, organised around an automated forward-test desk. 23 return-seeking strategy personas (plus 4 gated ones) trade open Kalshi contracts on paper twice an hour from a scheduled, read-only GitHub Actions collector, and every fill, exit, settlement, intent, mark and order book is committed back to the repository. value.description: Evidence-backed site for the DOE GEMS Prize Challenge on DrivenData ($300,000 total prize — $50k initial, $250k final — ending 2026-12-03): predicting geothermal faults in the GeoDAWN region under a distance-weighted Tversky metric, with a 19-band feature stack. Session-19 status read from STATUS.md: all four block-holdout folds are now committed and the memorisation-vs-transfer gap is reported as a spread rather than a point — fold 0 +0.0114, fold 1 −0.0070, fold 2 +0.0139, fold 3 +0.0093, mean +0.006904, spread 0.020935, positive in 3 of 4 — and because no fold reaches the ≥12 resampling units a readable block-bootstrap interval needs, the scorer itself flags every per-fold interval `interval_readable: false`, so the honest reading is 'no clear memorisation, no clear transfer gain' with the full-grid 0.099859 (reproduced digit-for-digit on a runner) retained as the selection statistic. The pseudo-label contrast is measured on every committed truth population and points in opposite directions on the two components, but it has now FIRED TWICE and STATUS.md is explicit that 'quoting either one alone would overstate the precision'. The first fire gave held-out blocks 0.0806 → 0.1841 (+0.1036, P=0.999) on the new-fault-like proxy against 0.2113 → 0.1239 (−0.0874, P=0.001) on catalogue labels, deriving TRADE_OFF_PROXY_GAINS_CATALOGUE_LOSSES; the second fire — same seed, same config, same partition, different runner — measured proxy +0.0677 and catalogue −0.1079, deriving GAIN_ON_THE_COMBINED_SURROGATE. That is a ~0.036 run-to-run swing on the proxy arm, the same order of magnitude as the +0.0313 union contrast itself, and the two scopes disagree in sign on the union (+0.0313 held-out against −0.0375 trained-on), which STATUS.md calls instability rather than a result. Read against the bar its own FIELD rule uses (paired block bootstrap P ≥ 0.95), the union contrast reaches P = 0.916 with an interval spanning zero on 8 scoreable blocks, so it is suggestive and not established; both fires' numbers remain in git history but the second overwrote the first's committed evidence files. Both verdicts carry `shippable_evidence: false`, and the circularity is derived rather than asserted, because the pseudo-label path is the same proxy_catalogue.tif the proxy truth is cut from. STATUS.md also defuses one coincidence on purpose: the baseline's union held-out DTI of 0.197183 resembles the public leaderboard's top score of 0.1972, and the two are unrelated quantities. A third population, the disjoint 122,652-pixel union (60,988 + 61,664, disjointness verified at score time), scores the shipped artifact 0.207431 CI95 [0.192924, 0.222879] and puts the adopted emission policy 2nd of 10 distinct emissions (50 swept, 40 pruned as duplicates) — the 1-pixel widening that beats it scores +0.0054 at P=0.815, below both pre-registered bars (P ≥ 0.95 and +0.010), so the adopted policy holds on a third population too, while the union arm that landed as run 35477119490 is recorded as suggestive, under-powered and not shippable. Session 18's pre-registered FIELD-selection rule (docs/FIELD_SELECTION_RULE.md), machine-gated first in reblend.yml, still returns KEEP mean12. Session 21 (2026-09-21) closed the standing data-placement blocker inside a sandbox: scripts/assemble_data_bridge.py reassembled all three official rasters from committed parts in 2.8 s, verifying every part sha256 and each whole-file sha256 against data/bridge/manifest.json (training_features.tif 418,912,844 B, labels.tif 425,830 B, sample_submission.tif 1,599,597 B), after which prepare_data.py PASSED on the placed bytes (3292x3730, 19 bands, EPSG:32611, 100 m, aligned bounds, band tags present). The CPU-only route to a submission was then re-executed end to end and reproduced the committed artifact byte for byte — the same selected policy (floor 0.000974, thin, width 0 px, union DTI 0.160259 on selection fold 0) and a submission.tif whose sha256 matches the committed baseline, with the generalisation audit re-scoring untouched fold 1 at catalogue 0.06597 / proxy 0.071107 / combined 0.078916, reproduced=True and max absolute delta 0.00016874; the two reports differ only in timings. validate_submission.py passed all 8 checks on the freshly written file, and the pre-registered support cap did its job visibly by excluding the highest-scoring candidate (floor 0.009487, union 0.197198) for emitting 487,813 px, 9.4% of the footprint, with the reason printed in the report. value.description: Auditable MLB research and paper-betting platform running the loop research -> discover -> verify -> model -> backtest -> forward-test -> paper trade -> analyze -> improve, with no bookmaker, exchange or order-placement client anywhere in the repository. It separates REG, POST, WC, DS, LCS and WS environments (ALL is a roll-up view, not a blended score), carries 68 versioned strategy hypotheses with immutable strategy and model version records, and keeps an append-only SHA-256 hash-chained ledger protected by SQLite UPDATE and DELETE triggers. A source snapshot has now been loaded via content-addressed api.github.com git-blob fetches, taking the repository from its earlier NO_SOURCE_SNAPSHOT state to SOURCE_SNAPSHOT: 28,072 tracked games of which 27,972 are completed, 144,098 ledger records and 441 upcoming bets. Its defining behaviour survives that change intact — settled_bets is still 0 and total_simulated_pnl is still null, because the backtest gate requires a verified timestamped quote before anything can be staked, so the 144,098 records resolve to 118,214 EVAL (calibration only) and 25,884 PROPOSED rather than to profit. The odds source it did find is recorded as PARTIALLY_VERIFIED and marked ineligible for paper PnL specifically because it carries no observed_at, available_at or closing_flag field. All 18 adversarial audit controls pass.

statement: MasterSite catalogs MLB Rain Delay — Live Scoreboard with Weather & Delay Tracking in Sports Data & Scoreboards; its recorded Pages status is built.

value.description: Zero-dependency static MLB scoreboard that adds, for every game on a date's slate, the official weather picture at the ballpark and a verified record of every delay, postponement and suspension. Three pages (index.html scoreboard, delays.html all-games delay feed, game.html single game) read the MLB StatsAPI for status, gameInfo.delayDurationMinutes, play-by-play game_advisory events and box-score info labels, and the US National Weather Service (points -> hourly forecast -> active alerts) for weather, falling back to Environment and Climate Change Canada for Rogers Centre and to Open-Meteo elsewhere (always flagged non-government-source). Delay rows are produced only from official MLB status data, never from a forecast; the derived forecast-risk chip prints its own six thresholds (HIGH/MODERATE/LOW/NONE/COVERED/UNKNOWN) verbatim from RISK_RULES in assets/js/weather.js. A captured copy of the full GET /api/v1/gameStatus registry holds 210 status rows, and three offline Node test suites assert 56 checks in total (26 delays, 24 weather, 6 render).
flags: Repository logs its own irregularities rather than resolving them silently: docs/verification.md sections 8 and 9.2 record four live findings from the 2026-09-21 pass (gameStatus N-family row reorder with identical 210-row membership, the registry endpoint ignoring fields=, fields= combined with hydrate= returning empty hydrated objects, and live box scores carrying more info[] labels than the captured fixture), plus six bugs found and fixed in section 9.3.

By design it does not scan Twitter/X, Facebook, Instagram, Reddit or news sites — the repository states a keyless static page has no verifiable way to read them — and instead links official club news, @MLB_PR, NWS and SPC pages under a Manual review heading. Its own Limitations section also records that browser CORS for the Environment Canada endpoint is still unverified and that some special-event venues have no coordinates.

value.description: Autonomous NHL betting-strategy research, discovery, backtesting, forward-testing and paper-trading platform, standard library only and with no order-placement code anywhere in src/. Its governing rule is that BACKTEST and FORWARD TEST results are never merged: the dashboard shows them side by side and only forward PnL moves a strategy's virtual bankroll. Backtest entries are priced from real timestamped Kalshi hourly candles (the yes_ask of the last candle ending at or before the scheduled start, tagged verification_status kalshi_candle_close); rows written before that history was recovered keep the weaker single_source_timing_unverified label permanently rather than being upgraded. A strategy with no fills reports a null win rate rendered as a dash, never 0%. State read from the generated site data at commit 5aac8c7: 66 strategies, 54 of them active in each mode, 3,490 settled backtest bets (+$2,221.89, 47.22% win rate) against 102 open forward bets with $2,692.24 staked and nothing yet settled, plus 74 irregularities, 157 findings and 21 sources. Its verifier cross-checks 5,248 team-game rows against the schedule with 0 score conflicts and 7,904 totals contracts with 0 conflicts.

statement: MasterSite catalogs Northstar Competition Lab — OLBG Tipster Paper Trading in Sports Data & Scoreboards; its recorded Pages status is built.

value.description: A deliberately small, evidence-first betting-research workbench whose central finding is that none of its strategies beat the market on the pilot sample. Football pilot: a 27-match Bundesliga 1 2024/25 sample (matchdays 1, 10 and 20, fixtures committed and sha256-verified) reached 27/27 dual-source result agreement between OpenLigaDB and football-data.co.uk on an exact-minute UK-time join, yielding 613 odds snapshots (405 on 1X2 plus 208 on a newly added over/under 2.5 goals market) across 9 strategies — all nine negative on both markets, with confidence intervals including zero and a Holm-adjusted p of 1.0. Sport two is ice hockey (DEL 2024/25) on the same open-licensed OpenLigaDB path, with overtime- and shootout-aware final-score selection and one Elo strategy that produces predictions only: 11 graded predictions, 7 correct (63.6%), Brier 0.4737, and PnL reported as unavailable rather than zero because no permissioned odds path exists for hockey. Sport three is darts (PDC), prediction-only, where the cold 2025 pool made 0 selections in 141 opportunities because the maximum probability of 0.551 never cleared the 0.60 threshold — recorded as silence with no refit — while the full 2025-26 pool graded 39 of 48 correct (81.25%) at Brier 0.349. Identity is labelled per sport: football verified, hockey and darts probable on a single source. 258 offline pytest tests cover fixtures, odds parsing, time-zone handling, settlement, walk-forward invariants and each pilot's guarantees, and every number carries a licence and a retrieval date with the ODbL attribution for OpenLigaDB stated on the site itself.
flags: Expanded substantially between the 2026-09-20 and 2026-09-21 audits: an over/under 2.5 goals market was added to the football pilot, a darts pilot became sport three, capture targets were extended to the Premier League, 2. Bundesliga and Ligue 1, and the test suite grew 144 -> 258. Earlier figures published here (405 snapshots, 13 hockey predictions at 9/13 and Brier 0.473) described the previous state and are superseded.

Open anomalies are carried, not cleared: 1 flagged on the pl/2026 capture (duplicate conflicting result rows, matchID 86559), 5 flagged source irregularities on the hockey pilot, and 2 on darts (matchIDs 79962 and 80237) plus one abandoned duplicate league excluded. A CET/CEST local-versus-UTC cross-check for OpenLigaDB rows was added this pass.
Prediction-only sports are kept off the PnL leaderboard by design and recorded as unsettleable rather than settled at zero, so the leaderboard covers football alone.

value.description: Source-verified rainy-season outlook for San Francisco ZIP 94122 (Sunset / Inner Sunset), 1 Oct 2026 – 31 Jan 2027, built by an automated nightly pipeline from free official sources (NOAA / National Weather Service, NCEI, Climate Prediction Center, U.S. Census Bureau). Each of the 123 days carries an NWS FORECAST badge (real gridded NWS forecast, ~7-day horizon) or a CLIMATOLOGY badge (observed 1991–2020 record for that calendar date at NOAA station USW00023272) — no invented daily numbers beyond the horizon. Landlord summary: mean 12.79 in seasonal rainfall, mean 34.5 wet days, 96.7% of seasons had a run of ≥3 consecutive wet days. New this pass: a ranked executive summary of repair and maintenance cost drivers — prolonged wet spells, heavy single-day rain, wind and rain together, peak gusts, total seasonal water load and wet-day frequency — each carrying its numbers and official source links, with the 'why it matters' sentence labelled guidance rather than a weather claim. Two figures published there are expected counts summed from the per-date 1991-2020 probabilities, about 15.0 days per season with at least 0.25 in of rain and 3.2 days with at least 1.00 in, and are labelled an expectation over the observed distribution rather than a prediction for 2026-27. The same summary also ships as one printable page, data/executive_summary.md, machine-generated by pipeline/executive_summary.py on every run.
flags: CPC outlooks are attached only as probabilities for a period and are never converted into daily numbers.

Withdrew its own unsourced claim in session 14 (commit e3c2fc4, its bug 74): the README previously called the SFO wind record 'an upper bound' for ZIP 94122 and now states that SFO is 11.9 miles away on the bay shore, that no official station inside 94122 holds a long wind record, and that no source in the project establishes whether the ocean-facing Sunset is windier or calmer — so the wind figures are SFO reference values, not a bound. A smoke test now fails any page text that calls it an upper bound. Session 14 also added an ENSO-phase-conditioned severity table (11 El Nino seasons averaging 3.7 days at 1.00 in or more against 3.2 over all 30, and 3.2 days with a gust of 40 kt or more against 2.4), with every row printing its own n, median and worst season beside the all-season figures, labelled observed rather than forecast.
